raw.title: Senior Product Manager
raw.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development:

  • Custom onboarding plan per role

  • Internal and external group training

  • Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events:

  • Annual seminars: a global seminar in France and a teaminar in your country

  • Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc.

  • Group activities: weekly yoga classes, monthly karaoke sessions, an indoor rock-climbing group, and participation in solidarity walks

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work:

  • 2-3 days in-office per week

  • Up to €500 reimbursed for remote work equipment

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT in 2026, with one taken for Solidarity Day

🍴 Meal vouchers (Tickets restaurants): Swile card with about 220€ per month

👀 Social & Economic Committee (Comité d’entreprise): Enjoy several benefits with HelloCSE

👩‍⚕️Health:

  • Health insurance (mutuelle) with Alan covered at 50% and available from your first day. You can extend coverage to your partner and children

  • Osteopathy sessions at the office, largely covered by UpSlide

🚆 Commute: Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • Flexible return to work options

  • Help for parents with children up to 6 years old: Either 4 days of fully paid sick-child leave, or, up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

🌳 Sustainability engagements:

  • Certified B-Corp since 2022, which means we not only care about profit, but also about people and the planet

  • Our founders pledged to invest 10 million euros in social and environmental solutions

  • Volunteer days: A paid working day where UpSliders volunteer to a charitable cause

  • Annual veggie lunch: A catered lunch with plant-based foods to raise awareness on the environmental impact of meat consumption and highlight a sustainable alternative

More about UpSlide

  • On top of exciting business challenges in a fast-growing market, you will find a friendly, caring, and challenging culture

  • You will be met with opportunities to acquire new skills, learn from others in a multicultural environment, and grow as a person

  • UpSlide employees have committed to making a positive impact on the world. We obtained B Corp certification in 2022 with strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. UpSlide is now 30% owned by employees. More info here: upslide.net/en/from-a-to-b-corp-our-mission-for-positive-impact/

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you've joined UpSlide ✨

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.&nbsp; Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.</p> <p><strong>This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.</strong></p> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></h4> <ul> <li>Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.</li> <li>Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.</li> <li>Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.</li> <li>Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.</li> <li>Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.</li> <li>Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.</li> <li>Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.</li> <li>Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.</li> <li>Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.</li> <li>Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.</li> <li>4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.</li> <li>Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.</li> <li>Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.</li> <li>Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.</li> <li>Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.</li> <li>Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.</li> <li>Fluent in French and English</li> <li>Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.</li> <li>Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.</li> <li>Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.</li> <li>Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.</li> <li>Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).</li> <li>Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.</li> <li>Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Senior Data Scientist
description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. About the Role Improving the quantity and quality of biological data is one of the most challenging bottlenecks to accelerate the rate of scientific discoveries in biology. In our labs at Orakl Oncology, we grow cancer cells from real patients, at scale, to generate our own experimental data. This data is deeply multi-modal and ranges from microscopic images, experimental metadata, to viability data and beyond. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the wet-lab data chain end-to-end: from raw instrument and screening outputs through to processing pipelines. You will work on the canonical data model for lab data, as well as building the validated, analysis-ready datasets and tools our scientists and downstream teams rely on. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role at the intersection of data science, production engineering, and experimental biology. You will ship and maintain code in production, define how we model experimental data, and build the quality controls and feedback loops that let the lab catch errors early and iterate faster. This is a role where you are expected to be in the lab, talk to scientists and lab technicians on a day-to-day basis. You will see how science is done in the lab, and then think hard about how to improve its impact. If you’re excited by complex workflows and the friction of real-life lab work, as well the power of data and AI, this position is for you. What You'll Do Own the lab-based data generation pipelines: to enable data transfer at scale from the lab to the cloud. This will involve building and improving production codebases that turn high-throughput experimental readouts into validated insights. Facilitate lab operations : Maintain and/or build tools to accelerate the work of Orakl Oncology scientists. Define and own the canonical data model: Design the unified data model that structures our data and is adopted across teams, ensuring data can be joined across modalities: experimental, clinical, omics, and clinical-trial event reporting. raw.title: Senior Data Scientist
raw.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

Improving the quantity and quality of biological data is one of the most challenging bottlenecks to accelerate the rate of scientific discoveries in biology. In our labs at Orakl Oncology, we grow cancer cells from real patients, at scale, to generate our own experimental data. This data is deeply multi-modal and ranges from microscopic images, experimental metadata, to viability data and beyond.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the wet-lab data chain end-to-end: from raw instrument and screening outputs through to processing pipelines. You will work on the canonical data model for lab data, as well as building the validated, analysis-ready datasets and tools our scientists and downstream teams rely on. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role at the intersection of data science, production engineering, and experimental biology. You will ship and maintain code in production, define how we model experimental data, and build the quality controls and feedback loops that let the lab catch errors early and iterate faster.

This is a role where you are expected to be in the lab, talk to scientists and lab technicians on a day-to-day basis. You will see how science is done in the lab, and then think hard about how to improve its impact. If you’re excited by complex workflows and the friction of real-life lab work, as well the power of data and AI, this position is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the lab-based data generation pipelines: to enable data transfer at scale from the lab to the cloud. This will involve building and improving production codebases that turn high-throughput experimental readouts into validated insights.

  • Facilitate lab operations : Maintain and/or build tools to accelerate the work of Orakl Oncology scientists.

  • Define and own the canonical data model: Design the unified data model that structures our data and is adopted across teams, ensuring data can be joined across modalities: experimental, clinical, omics, and clinical-trial event reporting.

  • Design and own data quality pipeline: Build QC that flags data quality at transfer time, and turn it into feedback loops so scientists can spot experimental errors early and integrate checks into their routine.

  • Support lab initiatives: such as automation initiatives, the development of experimental tooling to help lab scientists and technicians.

  • Drive operational efficiency: make sure that wet lab work is optimized to benefit the most from our resources (human and experimental) and ensure efficient contract and research delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 3+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining Python code in production

  • Strong hacker and tinkerer mindset. You like building things that have a real world effects.

  • Excellent proficiency in Python and SQL, and solid data-engineering skills: pipeline design and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or equivalent), version control (Git), testing/CI, and observability.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data-storage best practices.

  • Comfortable working with noisy, real-world experimental data and directly alongside non-technical scientists.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with experimental, assay, or high-throughput screening data.

  • Working knowledge of biology, ideally in oncology, cell biology, or drug discovery.

  • Experience with image analysis / computer vision applied to microscopy data.

  • Familiarity with lab data systems / LIMS (e.g. Benchling) and experimental workflows.

Who You Are

  • Curious and autonomous: you dig into scientists' bottlenecks, connect the dots across teams, and ship without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • A fast shipper: you get working solutions into production and iterate, rather than polishing in isolation.

  • A strong communicator: you gather needs from and explain your work to non-technical scientists, acting as the data bridge across the lab and beyond.

  • At ease in a complex and interdisciplinary environment: you thrive with messy data, evolving priorities, and external constraints that come with a science-first, non-pure-tech setting.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own the wet-lab data backbone of a techbio platform from the ground up: your work directly shapes how we discover and validate cancer therapies.

  • Sit at one of the most interdisciplinary intersections in techbio: data science, production engineering, and experimental oncology, side-by-side every day.

  • High autonomy and immediately visible impact, in a fast-growing, mission-driven company backed by leading investors.

Interview Process

  1. HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds. Founded in 2021, we’re a 65 -person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries , growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure. ⚙️ The role ScorePlay is the platform major sports organizations use to manage, search and share their media, from the second it's captured to the moment it reaches everyone's screen. A photographer uploads thousands of shots after the final whistle. A live feed has to be logged and clipped into highlights while the game is still being played. The right assets have to reach 10,000+ athletes, partners and newsrooms worldwide, automatically. At 145M+ minutes of video ingested every month and 15+ petabytes stored, much of the architecture needed at that scale simply hasn't been built before. We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our product engineering teams. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and sit on the engineering leadership team. This is a technical role. You'll need a deep understanding of how our systems work to prioritize well and propose the right technical solutions. Shipping code isn't your main priority, though. Your main priorities are building the environment that lets your team ship faster, the quality of its technical decisions, the people you grow, and the problems you solve before they become incidents. Understanding how everything works is a must. Shipping code is extra. 🔥 Why this is interesting This is a rare chance to work where engineering meets sports. You'll help build a unique, state-of-the-art product whose engineering challenges come from data volume and latency. Content has to be ingested, processed, searched and distributed at petabyte scale, often while the match is still being played. When the whistle blows, the platform has to be fast, and it has to hold. 🧠 What you'll own People Manage and grow your team: regular one-on-ones, clear expectations, direct feedback, growth plans that mean something. Handle performance head-on. Recognize what's great, address what isn't early and in writing, and see it through when it doesn't improve. Hire with our talent acquisition team: define the profiles your team needs, run interviews, and onboard new engineers so they ship in their first weeks. Technical direction Own the quality of your team's technical decisions: review and challenge designs, requests for comments (RFCs) and estimates. Drive foundational work from problem framing to production, and balance it against client commitments. Own your team's reliability: incidents, debug complex issues, postmortems, on-call health, and technical debt that gets paid down, not just listed. Product and speed Run your team's delivery with your product manager as one small team that shares context instead of handing it off. Make your team faster, every quarter. Take a feature that took twelve weeks and work out how it could have taken one: cut waste, automate what can be automated, and improve your processes. Define what can be delegated to AI and what needs thorough design and review, and set the guardrails that keep that line clear. Push back when a product decision doesn't hold up technically, and propose what would. Work with clients' technical teams on integrations and enterprise workflows when it matters. Be ready to get your hands dirty and go the extra mile. Sometimes it's all hands on deck, and that means you chip in too (and ship in). Beyond your team Prioritize topics that go beyond engineering, and work with stakeholders from other teams (product, sales, customer success, support) to move them forward. Contribute to engineering leadership: how we plan, how we run incidents, how we make decisions. 🛠 The stack and how we work Golang for services. PostgreSQL, Kafka, Temporal for workflows, OpenSearch, Kubernetes, all on AWS. We use AI heavily (but wisely), in the product and in how we work as engineers. Small cross-functional teams own their scope from conception to production. Structural decisions go through RFCs. Every week, the whole engineering team gets together to present and debate technical subjects. Every incident gets a postmortem, with real numbers attached. 🧩 What we're looking for 3+ years managing engineers as an Engineering Manager, after a solid run as a backend or platform engineer. You've managed underperformance to resolution, not only coached strong performers. A real technical foundation in backend and distributed systems. You don't need to write Go every day, but you can read an RFC on a search index or a Kafka topology and spot what's wrong. You've led a team through a significant architectural change while still delivering for customers. Initiative beyond your scope: examples of problems you owned across teams without being asked. Clear written communication. At ScorePlay, decisions are made in writing. A builder first. You've managed and you understand management in depth, but your instinct is to build and simplify, not to add layers and complexity. You've made a team measurably faster: shorter cycles, fewer hand-offs, more done by fewer people. Bonus: experience in a scale-up with 10–50 engineers, or on video, media or storage-heavy products. 📍 The setup Remote from Europe, remote-first with regular team gatherings, in an international team spread across Europe and the US. On-call is part of the role. When our platform is down, matches are happening without us. As an Engineering Manager, you're on the escalation path: when an incident needs coordination, decisions or someone to pull in the right people, that's you. Every incident gets a written postmortem with cost and impact attached, so the same thing doesn't wake anyone up twice. 🏆 Why ScorePlay Real scale, real stakes: 145M+ minutes of video a month, and the systems your team builds now become the foundations for years. The product is technical to its core, and it's what clients pay for. Engineering leaders are in the room for business decisions. No layers, no committees. A short line from you to the Head of Engineering and the founders. Your team's work shows up on match day, used by clubs, leagues and athletes you might already follow. An international team of 15+ nationalities across Europe and the US. We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration. About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge &amp; Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen &amp; AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical &amp; Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred..&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning &amp; Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

About Proxima

Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others.

Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.

In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us!

About You:

Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality.

Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models.

Projects may include designing large-scale scientific workflows for mining public and unique in-house data; developing novel systems biology and structural biology computational methods, tools and algorithms; and/or designing, training and fine-tuning best-in-class machine learning models. In our projects we apply induced proximity approaches to some of the most challenging targets considered “undruggable” as well as discover, build and develop novel proximity platforms spanning across multiple targets and disease areas.

We value individuals who want to make an impact, have a deep intellectual curiosity, enjoy solving challenging problems and have a track record of achievement. At Proxima, we believe that success is determined by talent and hard work, and individuals are given equal opportunities to grow and advance based on their abilities and contributions.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop pilot capabilities and create large-scale data pipelines from the ground up 

  • Collaborate with other teams across Proxima and partnering organizations to achieve project goals by contributing code, analyses, benchmarks, optimizations and ideas to ongoing research-driven projects

  • Integrate biological insights into the next generation of AI/ML models for drug discovery

  • Validate and interpret computational predictions by working closely with experimentalists 

 Basic Qualifications:

  • Hold an MSc or PhD degree in computational biology, bioinformatics or a related field

  • Possess mixed academic and/or industrial experience, preferably in the biotech industry

  • Have a strong background in computational structural or systems biology

  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in Python, R and/or other languages

  • Experience building reproducible and scalable computational biology workflows

  • Experience designing and applying machine learning models

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, protein language models, transformers and representation learning is a plus

  • Preferably have prior exposure to drug discovery problems

  • Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure

  • Agile project management

Full-Time Employees at Proxima enjoy these Perks*:

  • Highly competitive salaries

  • Company Equity Package, everyone is a stakeholder!

  • 401(k) + Company Match

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 13 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • Maternity leave 18 Weeks of fully paid leave + 6 weeks for Paternity leave

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

*for US based FTEs, country specific benefits apply for locations outside US

In This Role You Will Design, implement, and verify the FPGA fabric at the heart of our custom hardware, from real-time control and signal processing to high-speed sensor and data interfaces. Own the build flow: synthesis, place & route, static timing analysis, and timing closure on real silicon. Develop testbenches, simulation, and co-simulation to verify behaviour at unit and system level. Take designs from RTL through board bring-up, integration, and lab debug under real operating conditions all the way through to production-ready. Keep the design understandable: specifications, timing budgets, and verification plans. What We're Looking For Strong digital design fundamentals: RTL in SystemVerilog (or VHDL), and a solid grasp of computer architecture. The ability to reason about fixed- and floating-point data paths and pipelines - where precision goes, where it costs you, and how a computation maps onto real hardware. Experience closing timing: static timing analysis, writing constraints, clock-domain crossing, and synchronization. Fluency with at least one vendor toolchain (Xilinx/AMD, Intel/Altera, or Lattice), in a heavily scripted setting. Comfortable reading schematics, reasoning from first principles, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with electronics and mechanical engineers. The ability to take designs from benchtop prototype to production ready. Fluency in English (German not required, though useful!). raw.title: FPGA Engineer (Controls & Signal Processing)
raw.description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, implement, and verify the FPGA fabric at the heart of our custom hardware, from real-time control and signal processing to high-speed sensor and data interfaces.

  • Own the build flow: synthesis, place & route, static timing analysis, and timing closure on real silicon.

  • Develop testbenches, simulation, and co-simulation to verify behaviour at unit and system level.

  • Take designs from RTL through board bring-up, integration, and lab debug under real operating conditions all the way through to production-ready.

  • Keep the design understandable: specifications, timing budgets, and verification plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong digital design fundamentals: RTL in SystemVerilog (or VHDL), and a solid grasp of computer architecture.

  • The ability to reason about fixed- and floating-point data paths and pipelines - where precision goes, where it costs you, and how a computation maps onto real hardware.

  • Experience closing timing: static timing analysis, writing constraints, clock-domain crossing, and synchronization.

  • Fluency with at least one vendor toolchain (Xilinx/AMD, Intel/Altera, or Lattice), in a heavily scripted setting.

  • Comfortable reading schematics, reasoning from first principles, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with electronics and mechanical engineers.

  • The ability to take designs from benchtop prototype to production ready.

  • Fluency in English (German not required, though useful!).

Bonus Points If You Have

Having done these before is a plus, not a prerequisite. You'll do much of it in the role:

  • Rust or embedded firmware experience.

  • DSP in fabric: filtering (FIR/IIR), FFT, and fixed-point implementation.

  • Control theory: system identification, plant modeling, and loop tuning.

  • High-speed ADC/DAC interfaces and sensor/communication protocols.

  • Expert knowledge of version control, especially git.

  • Safety-critical or certified design.

  • Experience collaborating across analog, software, and mechanical domains.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. The Role As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering. No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams. Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments Responsibilities Lead user and customer research: plan and run qualitative, quantitative and field studies across installation, operation and maintenance (for example alongside our Application Engineers), and translate findings into product and design decisions. Design the user experience of our software platform: turn product requirements from Product Management and the Product Owner into information architecture, user flows and interaction patterns for complex, data-rich operator workflows (detect, assess, identify and classify), from early concepts to interactive prototypes. Propose and hand over UI designs to front-end developers: create high-fidelity, build-ready designs and specifications, align on feasibility with developers and the Product Owner, and review implementations for quality and consistency. Own end-to-end customer journeys: map the experience from in-field deployment and data acquisition through data processing to the software platform, including demo flows and supporting internal processes. Manage personas and customer insights: maintain the persona set and a central research repository, and synthesise learnings collected across the organisation. Validate and measure outcomes: run usability tests before and after release, define adoption and usability metrics, and report impact to stakeholders. Evolve and maintain our design system: extend the existing basis with UI components, patterns and guidelines that keep the platform consistent, accessible and efficient to develop. Partner across the organisation: work closely with Product Management, Product Ownership and System Architecture, as well as Sales, Business Development, Application Engineering, Support and Marketing, to prioritise development, reduce product risk and advance user-centred practices. Requirements Master’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in UX or product design, covering both user research and hands-on UX/UI design, preferably in defense or other technical, high-stakes industries. A portfolio showing end-to-end work, from research and workflows to high-fidelity UX/UI for data-rich professional software (e.g. situational-awareness, control-room or analytics applications). Experience working on integrated software platforms rather than isolated websites or prototypes. Experience handing designs over to front-end developers and working with and evolving a design system, with a working understanding of front-end technology and its constraints. Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and design proposals. Understanding of end-to-end systems in which sensor data is acquired in the field, processed and exposed on a software platform, ideally in complex or regulated environments. Able to translate complex technical workflows and data into clear, intuitive interfaces, with strong attention to visual detail, consistency and quality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; able to present research and designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in Figma and in research and collaboration tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Dovetail and Miro. Willingness to travel and do field research. Driver’s license B (or international equivalent). Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry. Nice to Have Big plus: Experience with underwater acoustics or sonar software. Plus: Experience in design leadership, or in setting up design practices in a growing organisation. Plus: Front-end skills (e.g. HTML/CSS, React) for prototyping next to AI based tooling. Plus: Proficiency in Dutch. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Fullstack DevOps Engineer (Trust and Identity)
raw.description:
Fullstack DevOps Engineer

In a technically exciting and fast-evolving environment, you will help us build digital trust products for organizations. Our team enables the use of verifiable information in business processes: eID, verifiable credentials, organization identity, KYB, digital signatures, PDF validation, trust chains, and secure onboarding flows.

Many trust, verification, and compliance processes are still manual, fragmented, and costly. We want to change that by building simple, secure, and easy-to-integrate products that allow organizations to verify information, trace it back to an authentic source, and create better user experiences for their customers and partners.

As a Fullstack DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and selected frontend capabilities for these products. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, UX specialists, and ecosystem partners to turn complex trust and compliance topics into reliable production services.

What impact will you have?

  • Build and operate backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot.

  • Design secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for eID, verification, onboarding, KYB, and compliance-related products.

  • Work with AWS services, databases, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure automation.

  • Model and manage data across relational and/or NoSQL databases with a focus on reliability, traceability, and performance.

  • Integrate frontend applications with robust APIs, authentication, authorization, and secure data flows.

  • Contribute to frontend features where needed using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

  • Take end-to-end DevOps ownership: from implementation and automated testing to deployment, monitoring, incident handling, and continuous improvement.

  • Help the team build market-driven products that create real value, not just technical functionality.


Must-haves:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience.

  • 5 years of professional experience in backend or fullstack software engineering.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and/or Kotlin.

  • Solid experience building services with Spring Boot.

  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and distributed backend systems.

  • Practical experience with AWS cloud services.

  • Good knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, and query performance.

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, Git-based workflows, and production operations.

  • Basic frontend experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular.

  • Ability to work in an agile, international, and cross-functional DevOps team.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with identity, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, OIDC, eID, digital signatures, onboarding, compliance, or regulated B2B products.

  • Knowledge of verifiable credentials, wallets, trust chains, PKI, certificates, or related digital trust concepts.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, queues, or asynchronous processing.

  • Experience with observability tooling, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

  • Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, accessibility, or component libraries.

  • Strong communication skills, pragmatic thinking, and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Want to know more about the team?

We build products that help organizations use trustworthy and verifiable information in digital processes. Our work focuses on reducing manual verification, improving compliance workflows, and creating secure infrastructure that can be integrated into real business use cases.

You will join a team working on emerging digital trust topics across Switzerland and Europe, including eID, organizational identity, verifiable credentials, Know Your Business processes, digital signatures, PDF validation, and secure onboarding.

We work closely with the market, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to build products that solve concrete problems for organizations.


Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are spark passion, aim high and stand true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance

  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth

  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!

  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office

  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family

  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance

  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance

  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms

  • Travel allowance reimbursement

  • 500 euros home office allowance

  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

  • Salary range: 60,000 to 65,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

  • Work from abroad possibility for one month per year

  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves

  • 25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

title: IT Architect - Business Domain
description: Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein.   Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen. Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten.    Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein:    - Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes.  - Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering.  - Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes.  - Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten.  - Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen.  - Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten.  Wat vragen we van jou? - Wo werk- en denkniveau.  - Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen.  - Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling.  - Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren.  - Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen.  - Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam.  - Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop.  - Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré.  - Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré.  Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. raw.title: IT Architect - Business Domain
raw.description:
Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein. 

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten. 
 
Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein: 
 
- Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes. 
- Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering. 
- Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes. 
- Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten. 
- Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen. 
- Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten. 


Wat vragen we van jou?

- Wo werk- en denkniveau. 
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen. 
- Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling. 
- Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren. 
- Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen. 
- Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam. 
- Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop. 
- Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré. 
- Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré. 

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt.
